relevance_note: Case report of a Chinese boy with a heterozygous TNFAIP3 variant ('NM_006290.3 c.653del p.Leu218TrpfsTer10, derived from the father') plus a review table (Table 3) of 15 earlier pediatric HA20 cases with their TNFAIP3 alterations.
method_note: Read the paper in full by hand. The index patient ('patient'), 'the father' and 'the mother' come from the case description, Tables 1-2 and Figure 1; rows labelled '1 (2)' to '15 (12)' come from the review table (Table 3) of previously published pediatric cases, labelled by the table's Patients cell (patient number plus reference number). A short Python script transcribed Table 3 cell by cell; I checked its output against the table and checked by script that every span occurs verbatim in the paper.
